literal: Those of wisdom who examine rare benefits will not speak words that do not have great benefit.
translation: Those who possess the wisdom to seek rare and precious benefits will never utter words that are devoid of great utility.
modern: அரிய நன்மைகளை ஆராய்ந்து அறியும் அறிவுடையவர்கள், பெரிய பயன் தராத வீணான சொற்களைப் பேச மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the connection between wisdom and purposeful speech. Wise individuals are described as those who analyze and seek rare, valuable benefits (arumpayan āyum aṟiviṉār). Because they value substance and truth, they naturally refrain from speaking words that lack any significant utility or great benefit (perumpayan illātha sol). The contrast between seeking 'rare benefits' and avoiding 'useless words' teaches us that true intellect is reflected in the fruitfulness of one's speech.
